en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes 453 points lower at 22841
en.dek: The benchmark fell 1.95 percent for a third straight day as Tencent dropped nearly 7 percent after results and Alibaba slid about 6 percent.
body: The Hang Seng Index closed 453 points, or 1.95 percent, lower at 22,841 on Thursday, extending its losing streak to three sessions. The index fell as much as 520 points during the day before paring some losses.

Technology shares led the decline. Tencent dropped nearly 7 percent after its third-quarter results showed revenue growth slowing to 8 percent from 11 percent previously, missing market expectations, while adjusted operating profit fell 6 percent. Alibaba slid about 6 percent ahead of its results, marking a tenth consecutive down day.

The Hang Seng Tech Index closed 87 points, or 2.33 percent, lower at 3,649. Lenovo, which swung to a net loss on Hong Kong accounting standards despite strong revenue growth, fell nearly 6 percent after an earlier 13 percent intraday drop. Meituan and Xiaomi each declined nearly 4 percent. Main board turnover reached about HK$229.5 billion.

zh.headline: 恒生指數收市跌453點報22841點
zh.dek: 恒指連跌第三日，跌幅1.95%，騰訊績後急挫近7%，阿里巴巴跌約6%。
body: 恒生指數周四收市報22841點，跌453點或1.95%，連跌第三個交易日。指數全日最多曾跌逾520點，尾市略為收窄跌幅。
科技股領跌。騰訊公布第三季業績後股價急挫近7%，收入增長由上季11%放緩至8%，低於市場預期，經調整經營溢利亦下跌6%。阿里巴巴在業績公布前跌約6%，連跌第十個交易日。
恒生科技指數收報3649點，跌87點或2.33%。聯想集團按香港會計準則轉為淨虧損，股價收市跌近6%，早段曾跌逾13%。美團及小米各跌近4%。主板成交額約2295億元。
